Our Services

What Tech Force Installs

From the initial site evaluation to final certification and documentation, we manage every phase of your infrastructure project.

Service 01

Data and Voice Cable Installation

Structured cabling, network and data center builds, IT closet buildouts and relocations, WiFi access point deployment. High-performance installations tested and certified to EIA/TIA-568 standards.

Learn More
Service 02

Fiber Optics and High-Speed Data

Single mode and multi-mode fiber installation, splicing, testing, certification, and demarc extensions. Built for the bandwidth demands of today's commercial networks.

Learn More
Service 03

Security Integration and Camera Systems

Access control, IP and analog camera installation, intrusion detection, and integrated security systems matched to your facility's protection requirements and budget.

Standards and Compliance

Licensed, Certified and Insured

Each network infrastructure is installed and tested by certified quality engineers and technicians. We provide extensive testing and generate reports using high-end network test equipment. Through this process we certify all data cabling installations to be in compliance with EIA/TIA-568 Standards for Commercial Building and Communications Cabling. All materials and workmanship are unconditionally guaranteed to be free from defects.

Licensed and Insured

Our Quality Guarantee

The performance of a network infrastructure depends not only on the quality of its components but also on the quality of the cabling installation. Tech Force unconditionally guarantees that all materials and workmanship are free from defects. Every project receives full testing documentation and certification reports.
